  if git -C "$L" merge-base --is-ancestor $c HEAD 2>/dev/null; then anc="IN-HEAD"; else anc="not-in-HEAD"; fi
  subj=$(git -C "$L" log -1 --format='%s' $c 2>/dev/null)
